messages:
elaine_sales: Heads up 1pm POC with BetaCorp. During load tests they started seeing bursts of 429s when sending large embedding batches. Need a quick triage for demo.
tom_eng: Can you paste a failed request id and the client concurrency they used?
elaine_sales: req id `beta-req-77` (2024-07-09T12:03:12Z). They ramped concurrency to 80 parallel requests and batch_size=32, model=embed-standard-2.
katie_support: Pulling logs for beta-req-77 now.
nish_infra: Log snippet:
```
[2024-07-09T12:03:12Z] req=beta-req-77 acct=beta-corp key=sk-beta-9 status=429 reason=per_route_cap limit=120/min current=128 concurrent=80 tokens=46080
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2024-07-09T12:03:35Z
```
elaine_sales: They eyeballed "120/min" and thought it was per-account, not per-route.
tom_eng: Right120 is per-route. Large batch_size * embedding token length = big token budget; combined concurrency caused short spike above cap.
katie_support: Short-term fixes: 1) set client concurrency to <= 16, 2) reduce batch_size to 8-12 for the demo, 3) exponential backoff on 429s with randomized jitter.
nish_infra: We can push a temporary per-route raise for the demo window to 360/min for 2 hours. Need account id, window, and a request in ops-quotas. @elaine_sales can you open ticket?
elaine_sales: Filing ticket now with acct=beta-corp id=beta-001 window=2024-07-09T12:45:00Z-2024-07-09T14:45:00Z. Ticket #Q-6009.
quota_bot: [system] quota request Q-6009 logged; estimated approval in ~8m.
tom_eng: Also recommend client-side fallback to smaller model (embed-lite-1) on retries so they don't hammer the same heavy model. That reduces tokens and latency.
elaine_sales: I'll ask BetaCorp to apply the client changes immediately and hold on the per-route bump until ticket confirms. Thanks all.
